exposure: implementation of a standardized protocol for postpartum anemia
cohort: The study included 805 postpartum inpatients at a single site, comparing those from a pre-implementation period (April 2021) to a post-implementation period (April 2022) of a new protocol.
finding: Implementation of a standardized protocol for postpartum anemia significantly increased intravenous iron (IVFe) use and was associated with shorter lengths of stay for postpartum inpatients.
followup_time: inpatient stay (up to discharge, average 1.69-1.81 days)
